Despite his record-breaking performance that saw him finish as the league's leading run-scorer with 776 runs, **Sooryavanshi** acknowledged the need for improvement in his fitness and expressed a desire to return stronger next season.  His ominous statement suggests he is hungry for more success.

recent_articles.title: RCB IPL 2026 win: Bengaluru police ban street celebrations after 2025 stampede - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bengaluru City Police** have banned public street celebrations following RCB's IPL victory, citing safety concerns and lessons learned from a deadly stampede in 2025.  The commissioner, **Seemanth Kumar Singh**, issued an advisory urging fans to celebrate indoors instead of on the streets. The restrictions follow a year after a crush during previous celebrations claimed 11 lives.

recent_articles.title: "Injustice Done To RCB Fans": DK Shivakumar Hits Out Over IPL Final Venue
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Virat Kohli** smashed a record-breaking 25-ball half-century for **Royal Challengers Bengaluru**, propelling them to a five-wicket victory over the Gujarat Titans in the IPL final.  The win marks RCB's second consecutive title, making them only the third team after Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings to successfully defend their championship. The match was played at Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, with **DK Shivakumar**, Karnataka Chief Minister-designate, expressing disappointment over the final not being held in Bengaluru due to political reasons.
